checks.detail: Work sees goal/charter/budget, own responsibility and org memory.
Dependency artifacts are inline; host file paths removed.
Ordinary work does not get org-wide roster/work/events or dependency task metadata.
Normal work exposes report_blocked, not organization decision tools.
Workspace unavailable without host binding; charter text does not grant host access.
Decision context sees full local work graph, roster and pending blocked event.
Decision role sees all local formal artifacts, not a fine-grained data access policy.
Budget summary exists, per-run usage/receipts/decision history query does not.
Decision role can change local organization, schedule work and wait.
No dedicated bounded observation query or resource/tool request workflow.
Memory, mandate update, local handoff and blocked work resume commit together.
One member may have multiple positions; schedule_work shorthand then rejects ambiguous assignment.
Explicit create_work by position remains valid for multi-position member.
Missing grant/request tool cannot be invoked.
Member exit, cross-AU evolution and governance/resource changes are not decision operations.
Unknown execution stops dispatcher before any new decision/model call.
Pending failure event/work summary visible, but this is not a persistent filtered history query.
Work objects lack stable lifecycle timestamps for wait/blocked-age metrics.
Identity is effectively scoped by AU; local ID equality is not a shared global Agent.
Unregistered member cannot acquire a local assignment; no cross-AU identity transfer protocol.
